# Opening Hours Specification

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:OpeningHoursSpecification`](gmeow-OpeningHoursSpecification.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/OpeningHoursSpecification>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/organization`](../../slices/organization.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A reified opening-hours window — a day (or set of days), an opening time and a closing time. Projects to [schema:OpeningHoursSpecification.](https://schema.org/OpeningHoursSpecification.) Reification keeps each window's day/open/close paired correctly when several coexist.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to reify one opening-hours window so its day(s), open time, and close time stay paired — necessary whenever a business has more than one window (weekday vs weekend).

### Avoid when

- Avoid a flat hours string on the organization (it loses the day/open/close pairing when several windows coexist) and avoid spanning incompatible days in one window; mint a separate window per distinct schedule.

### How to use

- Mint one [`gmeow:OpeningHoursSpecification`](gmeow-OpeningHoursSpecification.md) per window, set [`gmeow:openingDay`](../properties/gmeow-openingDay.md) (one or more), [`gmeow:opensAt`](../properties/gmeow-opensAt.md), and [`gmeow:closesAt`](../properties/gmeow-closesAt.md) on it, and attach it with [`gmeow:hasOpeningHours`](../properties/gmeow-hasOpeningHours.md).

### Examples

- ex:weekdayHours a [`gmeow:OpeningHoursSpecification`](gmeow-OpeningHoursSpecification.md); [`gmeow:openingDay`](../properties/gmeow-openingDay.md) [`gmeow:dayMonday`](../individuals/gmeow-dayMonday.md); [`gmeow:opensAt`](../properties/gmeow-opensAt.md) "09:00:00"^^[xsd:time](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#time); [`gmeow:closesAt`](../properties/gmeow-closesAt.md) "17:00:00"^^[xsd:time.](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#time.)
